context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA Push Notification features fully implemented and tested. All features working: 1) manifest.json served at /manifest.json with correct name 'MaxQ Dashboard', theme_color #500000, icons at /icon-192x192.png and /icon-512x512.png. 2) Service worker sw.js served and handles push/notificationclick events. 3) VAPID key endpoint GET /api/push/vapid-key returns valid public key. 4) Push subscription POST /api/push/subscribe stores subscription in MongoDB for authenticated users. 5) Test push POST /api/push/test works for admin only. 6) Push triggers implemented for: new material order (POST /api/material-orders), new lead (POST /api/leads), new project note (POST /api/projects/{id}/notes), and new sale (quote is_sold=true update). 7) Index.html has all PWA meta tags: manifest link, apple-touch-icon, theme-color, apple-mobile-web-app-capable.
